title: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2611.22299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether a foundation model succeeds as an autonomous agent depends as much on its runtime software as on its weights. This runtime, the agent harness, manages context and memory, steers multi-turn control, executes tool actions in sandboxes, and verifies work before stopping. Because models differ in how they use tools and how they fail, a static harness tuned for one model or task often stalls, wastes tokens, or regresses on another. This bottleneck has driven a shift from prompt tuning to self-improving agent harnesses: systems that inspect their own execution traces, separate runtime bugs from model limits, and rewrite their own code. We present a unifying architectural and design framework for self-improving agent harnesses. translated_title: 会自我改进的智能体支架：自我改进智能体支架的统一框架
translated_abstract: 基础模型能否成功胜任自主智能体，不仅取决于其权重，也同样取决于其运行时软件。这一运行时环境——即智能体支架（agent harness）——负责管理上下文与记忆、引导多轮控制、在沙箱中执行工具操作，并在停止前验证工作成果。由于不同模型在使用工具的方式和出错模式上各不相同，针对某一模型或任务调优的静态支架在其他场景下往往会陷入停滞、浪费令牌或出现性能倒退。这一瓶颈推动了从提示词调优向自我改进智能体支架的转变：这类系统能够检视自身的执行轨迹、将运行时缺陷与模型能力极限区分开来，并重写自身代码。我们提出了一个面向自我改进智能体支架的统一架构与设计框架。该框架将四个可编辑的运行时组件（上下文与状态、智能体控制、动作接口、验证与恢复）与一个四阶段循环相配对，该循环负责诊断故障、提出代码补丁并进行验证……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的架构与设计框架，将四个可编辑的运行时组件与诊断、修补、验证的自我改进循环相结合，使智能体支架能够通过检视自身执行轨迹并重写自身代码来持续自我优化。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unifying architectural and design framework that pairs four editable runtime components with a diagnose-propose-validate self-improvement loop, enabling agent harnesses to continuously optimize themselves by inspecting their own execution traces and rewriting their own code.
